entities.summary: Brian Farrell, LC is an Irish Catholic prelate who spent his career in the Roman Curia beginning in 1981, ending as secretary of the Dicastery for Promoting Christian Unity from 2002 to 2024. He is a member of the Legionaries of Christ. Brian Farrell was a religious figures from Dublin (b. 1944-02-08, Dublin).
